articles.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
articles.description: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.

articles.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
articles.description: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

articles.title: US military newspaper editor voices censorship fears after being fired
articles.description: Erik Slavin believes he was fired for saying in an interview that "in a hypothetical situation, censorship would be a red line".

articles.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
articles.description: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

articles.title: Two injured in stabbing attack at Canada Sikh temple
articles.description: One suspect is in custody, and police have said they are still investigating if the attack was motivated by hate.

articles.title: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
articles.description: About half of the 2,500 recorded deaths from Ebola happened in the last 20 days, the WHO says.

articles.title: '17-year-old girl killed' in sword attack at Swedish school
articles.description: A 17-year-old girl was killed when a teenager armed with a sword attacked students at a school in Sweden, reports say.
